Last month, after launching the first batch of GPT-6 models, OpenAI today announced brand new GPT-6 models designed specifically for everyday ChatGPT conversations, and simultaneously launched a new Intelligent UI. Details are as follows.

ChatGPT welcomes GPT-6 and Intelligent UI

OpenAI announced today that it will roll out GPT-6 Sol to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise subscribers on ChatGPT, while GPT-6 Luna will be gradually pushed to Free and Go users starting tomorrow.

According to OpenAI, this batch of GPT-6 models is specifically tuned for everyday conversations, and introduces Intelligent UI, a brand new feature that allows ChatGPT to dynamically combine text, visual elements, and interactive widgets based on the content of questions and answers.

The following is OpenAI's explanation:

With Intelligent UI, replies can include images, clickable buttons, tables, charts, and interactive experiences you can use directly within the conversation. The format will adapt to the questions you ask: comparison-type questions are best presented side by side, explanatory content may be easier to understand through interactive charts; and when a simple text reply is most useful, ChatGPT can respond in that way as well.

In a detailed blog post published today, OpenAI demonstrated how different prompts can generate answers paired with different visual aids.

For more complex prompts, ChatGPT can generate interactive widgets, allowing users to explore concepts or adjust inputs to observe how results change.

ChatGPT can now also build interactive tools directly within the conversation, such as calculators, bill splitters, and mini-games. OpenAI stated that with the launch of GPT-6, ChatGPT can start answering while thinking, gradually adding information into the reply without having to wait for the entire reasoning process to complete.
